captions.title: Ask for a map
captions.body: One sentence in pi. TinyPivot sums 2026 MRR by region on your machine and shades the world map.

captions.title: Every number checked
captions.body: North America leads at $17.12M. All eight numbers in the answer are found in the data.

captions.when: Message from the user in TinyPivot Studio: Which
captions.title: Ask the next one in the Studio
captions.body: Which plans grew, Jan–Oct like-for-like? Show it as a slope.

captions.title: A slope chart
captions.body: All four plans grew. Team fastest at +29.8%, Enterprise the largest gain at +$7.93M.

captions.when: Message from the user in TinyPivot Studio: Compare
captions.title: Actual against target
captions.body: Each region's 2026 MRR against 2025 as a bullet chart, in the deck layout made for slides.

captions.title: Check this answer
captions.body: Every region beat its 2025 target. The Studio reruns the SQL and finds all 13 numbers in the data.

captions.title: Ask in plain words
captions.body: One sentence about a 44,714-row file on disk. No schema, no SQL, nothing pasted into the chat.

captions.title: The chart prints in the reply
captions.body: TinyPivot read every row on your machine. Claude received a summary of about 540 tokens.

captions.title: Follow up for a few hundred tokens
captions.body: The file is already loaded, so the next question sends only the new instruction.

captions.title: A pivot table with sparklines
captions.body: Exact totals computed outside the model, with a trend column for every row.

captions.title: Narrow it to one segment
captions.body: Filters run on disk as well. Only Partner orders from 2026 are loaded.

captions.title: It finds the bad month
captions.body: Partner orders fell to 90 in March. Claude calls it out from the chart summary alone.

captions.title: A local model, on your own machine
captions.body: pi driving an open-weights model. TinyPivot does the arithmetic, so the model only has to ask for the chart.

captions.title: An area chart, in the green CRT theme
captions.body: Twenty-two months of revenue, drawn in braille dots and coloured by the theme you pick.

captions.title: Change the cut in one line
captions.body: Same file, new question. Nothing is reloaded and the model re-reads no rows.

captions.title: Stacked by plan
captions.body: Enterprise carries the business. The totals come from all 44,714 rows, not a sample.

captions.title: Same server, another harness
captions.body: One install command wires TinyPivot into every agent on the machine. Here it is in OpenCode.

captions.title: A ranked bar chart
captions.body: Channels sorted by revenue with shares, peak, low and average in the footer.

captions.title: Ask for the table instead
captions.body: The same data as a region by plan grid.

captions.title: Pivot table with a trend column
captions.body: Every cell is an exact sum. The sparkline shows the shape of each row at a glance.

captions.title: Antigravity, from the command line
captions.body: Google's agent reads the same MCP server. One sentence, one file.

captions.title: You approve each tool call
captions.body: The agent asks before it runs TinyPivot. The file never leaves your machine either way.

captions.title: Stacked bars by region and plan
captions.body: Four regions, four plans, 44,714 orders, drawn in the reply.

captions.title: Then the numbers behind it
captions.body: Ask for a pivot table and the exact figures come back as a grid.

captions.title: Pivot table with a trend column
captions.body: Channel by customer type, summed outside the model.
